changes: BGS startup explicitly supplies native tool_output_token_limit=10000 estimated tokens instead of unknown-model fallback 10000 bytes. Existing CLI truncation and smaller per-call budgets remain in force; no new config framework, retry or workflow stage.

Existing on-demand navigation names bun check-content.mjs --format uiLayoutContract and bun resources.mjs --contract registration. --format still lists other sections; schemas remain in existing owners.

validation.baseline: Before production change, the actual branded CLI with a loopback scripted Responses fixture truncated a 15KB generic reference and failed the new regression.

cases: new CLI process resuming the same thread receives configured output budget
nativeRegression.requests: 4 scripted loopback requests across start/resume; no external model endpoint
nativeRegression.note: This tests existing native output-budget semantics, not exact tokenizer counts or every native tool.

runnerAndNavigation.note: Three actual-browser paint/Preview cases intentionally skipped; all local runner and CLI navigation cases passed. Focused navigation case passed again after using filesystem access to check absent artifact directories.

validation.sandbox: Default sandbox blocked loopback listen; local test escalation approved, no permissions or production code relaxed.

selfReview: Only two production locations changed: configuration value plus comment, and one existing navigation string.
Full source pipeline verified through unmodified local CLI and its model-facing request; not merely a config-value assertion.
Resource and layout queries execute through existing generated adapters; no second schema, mandatory reading order or acceptance gate added.

Upper budget is native estimated tokens, not a promise of exact provider token counts. Returning previously omitted text can increase input; quality and aggregate token/time effects have not been model-tested.

No service restart or active task interruption. Existing running CLI instances keep their launch configuration; new configuration takes effect when BGS loads updated server code and starts/resumes a new CLI process.
Prior audit JSON is retained unmodified; no git commit was requested this turn.
